ops.text: Premise (csops CS_OPS_TEAMID forgeable under category 6 by a same-UID peer) is FALSE at the layer that matters. AMFI enforces OU==teamID at exec and SIGKILLs a forged-team binary before it can run and connect, so no live category-6 peer can present a forged team. internal/trust ships kernel-only as specified per G1 -- five csops_audittoken reads, NO off-handshake cert-chain check for the team clause. Threat-model caveat recorded: holds on a SIP-enabled machine; amfi_get_out_of_my_way / SIP-off is out of scope (an attacker who can disable AMFI machine-wide has already won).
